# Nouveau Monde Graphite to Participate in DOKAINISH BUILD’26


31 August 2026 -


[Matawinie](https://nmg.com/category/matawinie/) ,[Event](https://nmg.com/category/event/) ,[Investing](https://nmg.com/category/investing/) ,[Bécancour](https://nmg.com/category/becancour/)


## Delivering Canada’s Next Generation of Industrial and Infrastructure Projects at DOKAINISH BUILD’26


As Canada advances an unprecedented pipeline of energy, infrastructure and industrial investments, industry leaders are increasingly focused on one key challenge: turning major projects into reality. Taking place on September 17, 2026, in Toronto, DOKAINISH BUILD’26 will bring together senior executives and decision makers from across the energy, infrastructure, mining, finance and government sectors to discuss the conditions required to successfully deliver strategic large-scale projects across the country.


NMG is pleased to share that[Bernard Perron](https://nmg.com/about-us/#management-team) , Chief Operating Officer, will participate in the invitation-only forum alongside leaders from organizations including Agnico Eagle Mines, the Canada Infrastructure Bank, Infrastructure Ontario, RBC Capital Markets, Metrolinx and the Greater Toronto Airports Authority.


With more than 30 years of experience in the energy and infrastructure sectors and over $8 billion in projects delivered over the past decade, Bernard will bring practical perspectives on the conditions required to successfully advance major projects from planning through execution.


As construction of the Matawinie Mine continues and NMG advances the development of its 13ktpy Bécancour Battery Material Plant, for which a final investment decision is targeted in the second half of 2026, the Company remains focused on the execution of its fully integrated natural graphite and battery materials value chain.


To learn more about DOKAINISH BUILD’26 and the discussions shaping the next generation of industrial and infrastructure projects in Canada, visit the event website.


[DOKAINISH BUILD’26](https://www.dokainish.com/build26)
